events.command:
{
  echo "=== CANONICAL BRANCH ==="
  git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^origin/||' || echo "no remote (checking local)"
  
  echo "=== ACTIVE BRANCH ==="
  git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
  
  echo "=== BRANCH COUNT ==="
  git branch | grep -v '^\*' | wc -l
  
  echo "=== WORKTREE COUNT ==="
  git worktree list | tail -n +2 | wc -l
  
  echo "=== ALL BRANCHES ==="
  git branch -v
  
  echo "=== BUILD/TEST COMMANDS ==="
  if [ -f package.json ]; then echo "Found package.json"; grep -E '"(test|build|lint)"' package.json || true; fi
  if [ -f Makefile ]; then echo "Found Makefile"; fi
  if [ -f .github/workflows/*.yml ]; then echo "Found GitHub workflows"; fi
}
